name: My Little Sister Fiona
source:
After a traumatic experience at school, your little sister Fiona doesn't leave the house. Everyday occurrences like thunderstorms and even the mailman strike fear into her. As her older brother you do your best to make her home life as happy as possible so Fiona can smile every day. You can't imagine life without her mischief and laughter. How far will you go to make sure she feels safe and protected?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2196560/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在学校经历了一次痛苦的经历后，你的妹妹菲奥娜没有离开家。雷暴雨等日常事件甚至邮递员都会让她感到恐惧。作为她的哥哥，你尽最大努力让她的家庭生活尽可能幸福，让菲奥娜每天都能微笑。你无法想象没有她的恶作剧和笑声的生活。你会采取什么措施来确保她感到安全并受到保护？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2196560/]Steam[/url]]
